name: ANSI three-input OR gate
summary: Curved-back OR outline with three inputs; any one high input drives the output high.
description: The three-input OR uses the shield-shaped outline with a concave back and a pointed front, with a third input added on the curved back edge. Any input at logic 1 produces a logic 1 output. Triple three-input OR packages exist for this function.

Typical uses include combining several fault or request signals into a single command. The inputs should be identified by signal name so that a test engineer can trace which source produced the output when the logic operates.
The outline does not tell the reader whether inputs are filtered or latched. Any such behaviour must appear as separate elements before or after the gate.
readingNotes: Inputs meet the curved back, not a straight edge.
Trace each input to its source tag.
drawingChecklist: Terminate input leads on the concave back.
Show unused-input tie-offs for multi-input parts.
distinction: An exclusive-OR has an extra curved line behind the back; a plain OR has a single back curve.
